rule: Primary metric: dev vector (ANN) article Recall@5 over all answerable questions. Adopt 200/50 only if its primary metric is strictly higher than 300/50 and its dev keyword Recall@5 is not lower. Otherwise keep 300/50, the current default, which has fewer chunks to embed and store. Chunk count, embedding effort and latency are recorded but do not decide: one laptop, few samples. The test split is never used for the choice.
